data.description: Mid Unit | Prime Location | Immaculate Condition
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate proudly presents this beautifully maintained townhouse located in the prestigious Elan at Tilal Al Ghaf community — a modern family-oriented destination known for its exceptional lifestyle and premium surroundings.


  This middle-unit townhouse offers a thoughtfully designed layout with a spacious open kitchen concept that seamlessly connects to the living and dining areas, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere. Spanning 1,511 sqft, the home is presented in immaculate condition and is ideal for families seeking comfort, style, and functionality in a prime location.


  Positioned within one of the most desirable areas of the community, residents enjoy easy access to landscaped parks, walking trails, recreational facilities, and a variety of retail and dining options, all within a vibrant and secure neighborhood.


  Property Highlights:
  • Townhouse
  • Middle Unit
  • 1,511 Sqft
  • Open Kitchen Layout
  • Spacious Living & Dining Area
  • Immaculate Condition
  • Bright Natural Light
  • Modern Finishes
  • Prime Location
  • Family-Friendly Community
  • Landscaped Surroundings
  • Access to Community Amenities
  • Close to Parks & Recreational Areas
  • Easy Connectivity Across Dubai


  Tilal Al Ghaf continues to be one of Dubai’s most sought-after master communities, offering a balanced lifestyle with contemporary homes, green open spaces, and world-class amenities.
